# Techonrise Ltd

> Modernise, Automate & Grow: Full-Stack Digital Transformation, Technical SEO, Bespoke Software & Practical AI Automation for UK Businesses.

## Company Overview
- **Name:** Techonrise Ltd
- **Headquarters:** 124 Innovation House, London Road, Manchester, M1 4AB, United Kingdom
- **Operating Regions:** Greater Manchester, London, Birmingham, Leeds, Liverpool, Bristol, Glasgow, Edinburgh, Sheffield, Cardiff, and Nationwide across the UK
- **Email:** hello@techonrise.co.uk
- **Phone:** +44 20 1234 5678
- **Website:** https://techonrise.co.uk

## Core Philosophy & Commitments
1. **100% IP & Code Ownership:** Upon project completion, clients own 100% of custom source code, bespoke schemas, and assets with zero ongoing vendor licensing lock-in.
2. **In-House UK Technical Delivery:** No offshore subcontracts. All solutions are architected, developed, and maintained by experienced UK-based engineers and SEO specialists.
3. **UK Data Sovereignty & GDPR:** Encrypted databases, UK/EU data residency guarantees (London & Manchester cloud facilities), and full compliance with UK GDPR and Data Protection Act 2018.
4. **Performance Engineering:** Sub-second mobile loading speeds (LCP < 0.8s), WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility, and 95+ Google Lighthouse scores guaranteed.

## Five Integrated Service Practices
1. **SEO & Growth Marketing** (`https://techonrise.co.uk/services/seo-growth`)
   - Technical crawl audits, Core Web Vitals remediation, entity schema graph architecture, answer-engine optimisation (AEO for Perplexity, ChatGPT & Google AI Overviews), and local Google Business Profile map pack domination.
2. **Websites & E-Commerce** (`https://techonrise.co.uk/services/websites-ecommerce`)
   - Bespoke Next.js/React websites, headless Shopify Plus commerce flagships, high-converting landing pages, tokenised Figma design systems, and proactive maintenance retainers.
3. **Custom Software & Mobile Apps** (`https://techonrise.co.uk/services/software-apps`)
   - Full-stack web applications, multi-tenant SaaS portals, bespoke internal CRMs, cross-platform iOS & Android mobile apps with offline synchronization, and fractional CTO consulting.
4. **AI & Workflow Automation** (`https://techonrise.co.uk/services/ai-automation`)
   - High-intent inbound lead qualification and triage bots, grounded custom AI documentation assistants, automated PDF document parsing and invoice extraction, and Make/n8n CRM orchestrations.
5. **Hosting & Cloud Infrastructure** (`https://techonrise.co.uk/services/hosting-infrastructure`)
   - High-availability UK cloud hosting, Cyber Essentials readiness support, automated CI/CD deployment pipelines, 24/7 synthetic 60-second uptime monitoring, and air-gapped daily snapshot backups.
